code.pseudocode: Same objective and start; only the learning rate changes.
A small learning rate takes tiny steps.
After 10 steps the weight is still far from 3.
A good learning rate takes big steps at first, then smaller ones.
After 5 steps the weight is almost at the minimum.
A large learning rate jumps past the minimum on the first step.
The weight bounces from side to side around the minimum.
With a learning rate above 1 each bounce is bigger and the loss grows.
Compare the final loss after 10 steps for each learning rate.
